policy: Huawei jobs are collected only from the anonymous official Huawei Careers campus portal and the public XHR/fetch traffic emitted by that page. No login, resume upload, CAPTCHA handling, private cookies or access-control bypass is used.

sources.evidence: Huawei official campus page renders public jobData.result rows from HW.Portal.Reccamp.Job.findJobList; current default domestic graduate route uses jobTypes=2 and job detail links use jobId plus dataSource.
